title: Amazon Search & Best Sellers

queries.title: Search keywords
queries.description: Search keywords, e.g. ["wireless earbuds"]. Use ONE keyword per run when tracking each keyword: the same ASIN is delivered once across the whole run, so another keyword may lose that observation. For each result retain query, domain, page, position and fetched_at. position is the source page data-index; it is not a global or renumbered organic rank. Each delivered row costs $0.004. Either queries or categories is required.

domain.title: Marketplace
domain.description: Marketplace, e.g. "de" for amazon.de. Default "com". One of: com, co.uk, de, fr, it, es, ca, com.au, co.jp, in, com.mx, com.br, nl, se, pl, sa, ae, sg, com.tr, com.be. Rank and price differ per marketplace, so run each marketplace as its own run; prices come in the marketplace's currency.

department.title: Search department
department.description: Department to search inside, Amazon's own slug as in the search URL's i= parameter, e.g. "electronics", "kitchen", "books". Empty (default) = all departments. Use when the user names a department ("in Electronics").

pages.title: Pages per keyword or category
pages.description: Result pages per keyword or category, 1 to 20, e.g. 3 (default 1). A search page is about 20 organic products plus sponsored ones; a chart page 30. Walking stops early when a page adds nothing new. Cost = pages × rows per page × $0.004: 3 keywords × 2 pages is a little over 100 rows.
pages.sectionCaption: How many rows, which rows (filters run before billing)

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max products per keyword or category
maxResultsPerQuery.description: 0 (default) = every unique ASIN found within pages. N caps the collected rows per keyword/category BEFORE skipSponsored and minRating; those filters can leave fewer than N paid rows. Collection stops at N, the page limit or a page with no new ASINs. Each ASIN is delivered only once across all queries/categories in the run. At most N × $0.004 per target when N > 0; use callOptions.maxTotalChargeUsd for the MCP dollar ceiling.

skipSponsored.title: Skip sponsored results
skipSponsored.description: true drops rows flagged sponsored before billing; false (default) keeps them. It does NOT renumber position: that remains Amazon's data-index on its page and can have gaps. Use for organic product results, not an exact global organic rank. With maxResultsPerQuery=N, ads are removed from the first N collected rows, so fewer than N may remain. Keep page with position when comparing snapshots.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Keep only products rated at or above this, e.g. 4 or 4.5. 0 (default) = every product. Products without a rating are dropped too. Filtered rows are never charged.

categories.title: Category charts
categories.description: Category slugs to pull a chart for instead of (or as well as) keywords, e.g. ["electronics", "kitchen", "books"]: the segment after /gp/bestsellers/ in a Best Sellers URL. A chart page renders 30 of its 50 entries; for every rank of the Top 100 use kestrel/amazon-best-sellers-scraper. Empty (default) = no charts.

chart.title: Chart type
chart.description: "bestsellers" (default) or "new_releases": which chart to pull for each category above. Ignored for keyword searches. Movers & Shakers is not available (Amazon renders it client-side; the page carries no products).

sessions.title: Parallel sessions
sessions.description: Parallel proxy sessions (one egress IP each), 1 to 16, e.g. 4 (default 4). More is faster for long keyword lists; each session is paced separately.

perIp.title: Requests per second per IP
perIp.description: Requests per second per session, 0.1 to 2 (default 0.5). Amazon tolerates about 0.5/s per IP; faster causes captchas, not speed. Leave the default.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy, default {"useApifyProxy": true} (datacentre). Required: Amazon captchas unrotated datacentre traffic and refuses search pages from whole datacentre ranges for minutes at a time; the run rotates the IP on a captcha or 503 and after two refusals in a row moves to residential proxies by itself. Pass {"useApifyProxy": true, "apifyProxyGroups": ["RESIDENTIAL"]} for the most reliable runs.

description: Amazon search results: {"queries":["wireless earbuds"],"pages":2,"maxResultsPerQuery":20,"skipSponsored":true}. Up to $0.08 at $0.004/product; filters can reduce rows. The cap applies BEFORE filters. position is Amazon's page data-index, not a renumbered organic or global rank. For keyword tracking, run one keyword per run: ASINs are deduplicated across all queries. Set callOptions.maxTotalChargeUsd outside input in MCP. Charts here contain partial pages; use the Best Sellers Actor for Top 100.
